hints.title: Two pieces
hints.body: Separate each addition into sum bits and carry bits.

hints.title: XOR and AND
hints.body: XOR gives the sum without carries; AND shifted left gives the carry positions.

hints.title: Repeat
hints.body: Add the carries back using the same two operations until there are no carries left.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
while b != 0:
    carry = (a AND b) shifted left by 1
    a = a XOR b
    b = carry
return a
```

For languages whose bitwise operations are signed 32-bit, mask intermediate values to 32 bits and convert the final pattern back to a signed value.

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
